Update, October 7: Apple has also released two RC builds to public beta users. The build numbers are the same as the developer RCs.

In addition to releasing macOS 27.2 Golden Gate public beta 2, Apple is also beginning to roll out the first release candidates for macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. Here are the details.

Older macOS versions continue to receive security updates

As is customary for minor updates to older macOS versions, Apple today pushed out the first release candidates for macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 directly, without first seeding standard beta builds.

Apple released macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 late last month, both of which went through two release candidate builds before their official rollout.

Apple's release notes for the first RCs of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 only state that they "provide important security fixes and are recommended for all users." Last month's updates included a CoreGraphics security fix, which was described as follows:

Apple will very likely wait until after macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 are officially released before detailing the fixes inside, with the final versions expected to ship in the coming weeks alongside macOS 27.2 Golden Gate.

The release version number for macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 RC 1 is 24H219, while the release version number for macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 RC 1 is 25G320.

Have you spotted any new features or changes in today's RC builds? Let us know in the comments.
